facts.fact: The World Bank's June 2026 status report on the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project lists as a key achievement the signing of the first cross-border digital connectivity MoU between Kenya and South Sudan, a model for the remaining bilateral MoUs; the signing date is not given, so the report's published date is used.
facts.system: Kenya-South Sudan cross-border digital connectivity MoU

systems.system: Kenya-South Sudan cross-border digital connectivity MoU
systems.country_label: Cross-border digital connectivity Memorandum of Understanding
systems.owner: Kenya and South Sudan governments under the World Bank-financed EARDIP

note: The first competitive tender for fibre deployment in South Sudan is only expected in the second half of 2026, so no building or service fact.
